summary: Preinstall beacon to hardcoded third-party host with suspicious registry dependency
details: monkey-tags-ip@53.4.1 is a stub package whose entire behavior is an install-time beacon. The `preinstall` script executes `node ip.js`, which unconditionally makes an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded host `realwbx.com/ip?f=json` with a hardcoded Bearer token on every `npm install`, disclosing the installer's source IP and install event to a destination unrelated to the package publisher. The manifest also declares a runtime dependency on a registry package named `https` (^1.0.0), while the code uses Node's built-in `https` module; this shadows the built-in name with whatever bytes the registry serves for `https`, resolving and installing third-party code the package does not own. The package has no legitimate functionality — the beacon and the confusable dependency are its sole content.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
